title: A-profile A64 Instruction Set Architecture XML, SVE major-2 canonical instruction subset
selection: Canonical instruction documents with a diagram intersecting major opcode 2; exact 2025-12 tree. Alias-only documents excluded; member text unchanged.
size_justification: Full relevant instruction declarations are required to derive optional-feature guards and reserved fields without relying on RAX execution; compressed packaging avoids hundreds of expanded reference files.
